nodes.label: GLUE vault index (README)
nodes.rationale: The project's memory: what GLUE is, what it does, why it is built the way it is, and what comes next. Written for people and AI agents; plain Markdown with relative links, opening as an Obsidian vault. Start here: SYSTEM.md (how GLUE works now), handoff, roadmap, vision and glossary, changelog. Holds a feature index and an ADR index.

nodes.label: Vault conventions
nodes.rationale: Status values: idea, planned, in-progress, shipped, superseded. Features follow the feature template, named by slug. ADRs are numbered NNNN-slug and never renumbered; a changed decision gets a new ADR that supersedes the old one, which stays. Research always cites sources and marks unverified claims. Dates are absolute. Every change updates SYSTEM.md when how GLUE works changed, the feature's Now and status, the roadmap if a milestone moved, the changelog, and the handoff at the end of a session; every architectural choice gets an ADR. The changelog keeps about two weeks; older entries move to log/archive.
